Remove obsolete Picker capacity settings

  description: |-
    Remove the legacy single-capacity fallback and inactive observer setting from strict Picker configuration. Resolve, schedule, and persist claims through the explicit total-active and runnable capacities only, with a v2 canonical policy digest that leaves stored v1 evidence untouched. Update focused tests, examples, the normative runtime specification, and OpenWiki architecture guidance.
